note: The main banks were taken as Romania's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): Banca Transilvania, BCR and BRD. BCR: its costs for the BCR Standard and BCR Gold credit cards (undated; the copy its site serves on 2026-10-30), read 2026-10-30. Each bears a fixed 28% a year on an unsecured card (23% on one secured by a deposit, which the game doesn't hold); a payment missed adds 3 points to the current rate on the overdue principal of the minimum, written as a penalty rate of 31%. The Standard costs 20 lei to issue and 45 a year to administer; the Gold 100 to issue, 200 a year to administer and 20 a year for its insurance. Cash at an ATM or POS costs 3%, at least 10 lei, and spending in another currency 2%. The documents state no minimum payment, grace period or late fee. Banca Transilvania's card pages answered with a captcha; BRD's card fee guide on its site is the one in force from 1 January 2020, too old to stand for today's terms, and no current one was found. Neither is written. In wave 4 (2026-10-30) Raiffeisen Bank Romania's card pages answered with a captcha, UniCredit's and CEC's refused the request (403), ING's and BRD's credit card pages weren't at the addresses tried (404), and a search for the banks' standard information forms found none; no bank was added. No minimum payment is published for BCR's Standard and Gold cards; tried: its tariffs and the BUN DE PLATA cost sheets and programme rules (read 2026-10-30; they name the 'Suma Minimă de Plată' without its figure), its card pages (404 at the addresses tried), a search in Romanian (a press article citing 5%, not a source), and archive.org's availability API (its snapshots can't be read: web.archive.org is refused by this environment's egress), which lists no snapshot of its card page.
